record.field: This step pushes the translations to Transifex. It can be executed after any "all" config step that creates databases.

commit_links = build.params_id.commit_link_ids.filtered(lambda x: x.match_type in ['new', 'head'] and x.branch_id.transifex_project_id) transifex_projects = commit_links.mapped('branch_id.transifex_project_id')
tx_data = [] # list of tuples with [(token, organization_slug, project_slug, modules)] for transifex_project in transifex_projects: modules = [] commits = commit_links.filtered(lambda x: x.branch_id.transifex_project_id == transifex_project).mapped('commit_id') for commit in commits: modules += [x[1] for x in commit._get_available_modules()] tx_data.append(( transifex_project.tx_token, transifex_project.organization_slug, transifex_project.slug, modules))
env_variables = [ 'tx_data=%s' % tx_data, ]
build.params_id.write({"skip_requirements": True}) cmd = build._cmd()
# Buscamos la base que arranque con "all" por si hay otras bases generadas como "base" db_name = build.database_ids.filtered(lambda x: x.db_suffix.startswith(self.db_name)).name
if db_name: cmd += ['-d', db_name] cmd += ['-i', 'transifex_push'] cmd.append('--stop-after-init') cmd.append('--max-cron-threads=0') docker_params = { 'cmd': cmd, 'env_variables': env_variables, 'log_path': log_path, 'build_dir': build._path(), 'container_name': build._get_docker_name(), 'ro_volumes': build._checkout(), }
else: build._log('', 'No se encuentra una base de datos con el nombre indicado', level='ERROR')
